features: Ultra-Lightweight & Portable Design – Weighing less than 57 g, this compact wireless mouse is easy to carry, reducing hand fatigue while delivering comfortable all-day use at home, work, or on the go.
Quick-Release Carry Strap – Features a durable pop-out finger strap for a secure grip and effortless portability, making it easy to carry your mouse wherever you go.

ASUS Antibacterial Guard Protection – The surface is treated with an antibacterial coating scientifically proven to inhibit over 99% of bacterial growth within 24 hours, helping keep frequently touched areas cleaner.
Near-Silent Clicks – Quiet-click buttons produce less than 20 dB of noise, allowing you to work, study, or browse without disturbing people around you.
Built to Last – Engineered with durable switches rated for 10 million clicks, delivering over 3X the lifespan of conventional mouse buttons for long-lasting reliability.
Adjustable DPI Precision – Choose between 800, 1000, or 1600 DPI to achieve smooth, accurate cursor control across different screen resolutions and work styles.
description: Asus Marshmallow MD100 Wireless Mouse, Lilac Mist Purple, (Brave Green cover also included)
